cases.rationale: People eat at a round outdoor dining table with individual slatted chairs, stemmed drinking glasses, forks and table knives. The white rectangular vessels are cartons, not bottles. A small blue vessel beside the woman's glass does not show enough structure to settle cup identity (41 unclear). Small green and orange food portions could include broccoli and carrot, but their vegetable identities are not secure at this resolution (50 and 51 unclear). The plates and other food do not establish bowls, pizza or sandwiches. Garden greenery has no identifiable pots, and the blue foreground cloth is not an identifiable bag. All 75 frozen definitions were considered across the entire crop; remaining categories have no qualifying visible object.

A tangible brown bear-shaped stuffed toy with stitched muzzle and toy eyes occupies the upper right, establishing teddy bear and excluding actual bear. Its pink neck ribbon is not an identifiable necktie. The blue smiling cup-shaped object is a crocheted toy/representation, rather than an actual drinking vessel under the common toy exclusion. Printed graphics and the patterned backing do not establish other objects. I considered every frozen definition, including all other animals, vessels, furniture and tools; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The crop contains children and adults, a girl's clearly tined fork, a printed paper drinking cup, cheese pizza on red plates, and a purple eating-table surface. Several necked drink bottles are visible along the rear surface. Dark seat-like pieces behind the girl are too obscured to identify a chair confidently (56 unclear). The plates are shallow plates rather than bowls; the pizza is not sandwich, cake or a separately identifiable vegetable item. The orange strap at the right does not reveal a backpack or handbag body. All 75 definitions were individually considered over the whole crop.

Two standalone computer displays, white desktop keyboards and a white computer mouse are identifiable. The left display sits with a separate compact computer unit, rather than an integrated laptop base. The wooden surface is a computer work desk, which is excluded from dining table. Screen contents and loose papers are not actual depicted objects or bound books; the mouse mat is not another device. All 75 frozen definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The red paired finger loops and joined metal cutting blades identify actual scissors. Their blades are parts of the scissors, not a separate knife. The rest of the crop is a plain pale supporting surface with shadows, without an identifiable dining-table context. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

A man's face and hand are visible as he brings a sugar-coated doughnut held in paper toward his mouth. The browned round pastry with its sugary coating supports donut rather than a plain bagel, cake or sandwich. Numerous actual necked bottles line the bar behind him. The white wrapping is paper rather than a utensil or vessel; the rear counter is not an identifiable dining table. I considered all 75 definitions across the crop and found no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual orange cat lies in an open travel suitcase with rigid wheeled base, zipper, handle and lid. The surrounding pillows, sheets and mattress establish a bed. Clothing and dark fabric around the suitcase do not identify a backpack, handbag, person or another animal. The cat is not a plush or bear. I explicitly considered all 75 frozen definitions over the whole crop; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two people in scout uniforms are visible with an open laptop whose rear screen panel faces the camera. An integrated keyboard is concealed and therefore does not establish keyboard presence. Their knotted neckerchiefs are scarves rather than neckties. The surface holds presentation equipment, microphones and papers in work context, not a supported eating-table identity. A narrow pale structure behind the seated woman's left shoulder could be a chair back but is too occluded to settle chair identity (56 unclear). The background emblem is a graphic. All 75 definitions were considered.

A deep bowl of orange-red soup sits on a plate with toast, and an actual spoon shows its bowl and long handle below the soup bowl. The drink at the right is in a stemmed wine-glass form with foot, excluding cup. The setting establishes a dining table. The toast has no supported sandwich filling, and the smooth soup does not identify carrot, orange, or another listed food solely by its color. The printed coaster is not a book. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The close animal's head, ears, muzzle and striped neck clearly identify a real zebra, not a horse. The ochre patches bounded by pale polygonal lines on the partially visible animal behind its right side identify a giraffe body portion. A person's head and torso are visible at the left, and a passenger vehicle's side/window and mirror occupy the right edge. Unpotted vegetation is not potted plant. I considered all 75 definitions across the entire crop; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The tower has clearly identifiable actual time-of-day clock faces with hands and hour markings. The foreground horses and human figure are bronze sculptures, so they do not count as actual horse or person under the frozen common rule. The bare tree has no pot, and architectural details are not furniture or vehicles. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The room contains a central time-of-day mantel clock, tall decorative flower vases, small drinking teacups arranged with teapots, necked bottles at the left, and individual wooden chairs at the edges. The furniture supports a ceremonial display rather than an identifiable dining/eating table. Partly cropped greenery and containers at the edges do not establish whether actual plants are growing in pots (58 unclear). Small flat stacked objects behind the foreground table may be books, but bindings/pages are too indistinct to decide (73 unclear). Birds and flowers in the wall artwork are depicted images, not actual birds or plants. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.
